model_output.score_comment_short: The internship names relevant tools, but most bullets leave the work unexplained.
model_output.score_comment_long: The analytics internship shows reporting, survey data cleaning, and a Tableau dashboard. Most bullets stop before explaining what those deliverables contained or how they were used. Adding those details would make the work easier to assess.
model_output.score_plain: The resume shows relevant entry-level analytics exposure, but a reviewer has limited detail for comparing your work with a role's requirements.
model_output.first_impression: Your credit union internship puts Excel, SQL, and Tableau in a work setting rather than only a skills list. The dashboard's marketing audience is worth keeping because it gives the work a clear recipient.
model_output.biggest_gap_example: "Presented findings to the team at the end of the internship" does not say what you found, so a reviewer cannot tell what analysis you communicated.
model_output.summary: The Data Analytics Intern role is the center of this resume, with reporting, data cleaning, dashboard work, and a presentation during the internship. Alongside your expected B.S. in Information, it positions you for entry-level analytics work. The resume does not yet explain what the dashboard showed or what the survey analysis found, leaving the substance of your work difficult to assess.
strengths: Cleaning member survey data in both Excel and SQL connects named tools to a specific data source.
Weekly reporting shows a recurring responsibility rather than a one-time task.
Managing the Michigan Data Science Club budget and reimbursements adds financial administration experience outside the internship.
gaps: The survey bullet does not say what data issues you addressed, so the cleaning work is difficult to distinguish from a routine description.
The presentation does not identify a finding or its topic, leaving your analytical communication mostly unexplained.
The club budget entry does not describe the types of spending or reimbursement decisions you handled, which limits the picture of your treasurer responsibilities.
